# WEATHER VAULT: Hurricane Bob 1991 MEMPHIS, Tenn\. \(WMC\) - Hurricanes in the Northeast are rare enough, but did you know the most recent hurricane landfall in the region was during an El Niño? Between July and September of 1991, the Niño 3\.4 region was 0\.7 degrees Celsius, 1\.26 degrees Fahrenheit above average\. At the same time, Hurricane Bob made landfall as a Category 2 hurricane on the coast of Rhode Island\. The storm formed in the early hours of August 16, 1991 as a tropical depression before being named a tropical storm later that day\. By August 17, 1991, Bob became a Category 1 hurricane off the east coast of Florida, but a cold front approaching the east coast quickly picked it up and accelerated it northwards\. Bob strengthened into a Category 3 major hurricane off the coasts of North Carolina and Virginia on August 18, 1991\. By the afternoon of August 19, 1991, Bob made landfall as a Category 2 hurricane on the coast of Rhode Island\. Bob continued to track across New England, bringing a swath of damage through Rhode Island and Massachusetts before making another landfall as a tropical storm on the coast of Maine that evening\. # How El Niño is neutralizing Atlantic hurricanes this season PTIThis NOAA satellite image taken at 11:21 a\.m\. EST on Wednesday, Aug\. 12, 2026, shows Tropical Storm Cristobal in the Atlantic Ocean\. The Atlantic hurricane season is showing signs of activity just as a powerful climate pattern threatens to keep tropical storms in check\. Cristobal became the third named storm of the 2026 Atlantic hurricane season on Wednesday, but the system quickly weakened into a tropical depression over the open North Atlantic\. It is expected to dissipate by Thursday afternoon, according to CNN\. The brief appearance of Cristobal comes as forecasters watch two other areas of disturbed weather in the Atlantic\. One has an 80% chance of developing into at least a tropical depression later this week, while another area farther east has a 50% chance of development\. If another tropical storm forms, it will receive the name Dolly\. ## El Niño remains the biggest obstacle The Atlantic may be approaching the period when hurricane activity normally begins to accelerate, but conditions are far from ideal for storms\.
